8254.title: Local image identity survives preview refetches
8254.rootCauseOneLine: Preview refetches discard the query update timestamp, leaving local Markdown image source URLs unchanged even when the query finishes successfully.
8254.proposedFix: Version locally resolved image URLs with the preview query's successful-update timestamp, covering manual and background refetches even when Markdown text is unchanged.
8254.caveats: Reproduced at the rendered DOM boundary in two clean checkouts. Browser Automation was blocked by missing Chrome/Chromium; decoded-image cache behavior and macOS were not pixel-verified. No new image-only disk watcher is added.
